column1: # description: API inference pricing and latency data for major LLMs

# notes: Updated to 2026 model landscape. Prices from official provider pages and OpenRouter (March 2026). Latency from ArtificialAnalysis.ai (August 2026). Context windows from official documentation. Prices in USD per 1M tokens. o3 pricing excludes reasoning tokens (billed as output). DeepSeek V3 pricing reflects direct API; V3.2 is cheaper but V3 still widely served. Latency values are median Time to First Token (TTFT) in milliseconds across API providers.
